title: Troubleshooting & FAQ
desc: Common issues and how to resolve them.
lede: Stuck? Start here. These are the issues people hit most and how to clear them.
body:
At a glance
  • Failed jobs & retries.
  • Voice quality problems.
  • Enabling an optional cloud engine.
  • Long-sentence warnings.

Failed jobs & retries

Open the job in the queue and read its reason. Most failures are setup-related (engine not ready, missing dependency) and clear after a retry.

Voice quality

Poor clones usually trace back to samples. See Voice Cloning Quality.

Enabling an optional cloud engine

Add the provider's API key in Settings. Cloud engines stay hidden until a key is present. See Cloud Engines.

Long-sentence warnings

Very long sentences may be split for the engine. If you see a warning, shortening or re-punctuating the sentence usually helps.
